WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.276585 37.773754)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1000 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.276585, 37.773754), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_clipped AS (
  SELECT
    (ST_Clip(rast, 1, ST_Buffer(p.geom::geometry, 10000, 'quad_segs=8'))).geom AS clipped_geom
  FROM
    public.dem_us,
    poi_geom p
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(rast, p.geom::geometry)
),
terrain_above_1000 AS (
  SELECT
    ST_DumpAsPolygons(clipped_geom, 1) AS (geom geometry, value double precision)
  FROM
    dem_clipped
  WHERE
    value > 1000
),
nearest_point AS (
  SELECT
    ST_ClosestPoint(t.geom, p.geom::geometry) AS nearest_point_geom
  FROM
    terrain_above_1000 t,
    poi_geom p
  ORDER BY
    ST_Distance(t.geom, p.geom::geometry)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ST_Distance(p.geom::geometry, np.nearest_point_geom) AS distance_meters
FROM
  poi_geom p,
  nearest_point np;
